plainText:
Justin Anselmi is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Anselmi was born on September 18, 1984, in Paola, Kansas. As an adult, he became an actor, getting only minor roles in lesser-known films and TV shows. He eventually joined the during . Several of the roles Anselmi has taken on were previously voiced by Tom Wayland.
